tonight.headline: Los Cachanillas added Cousins overnight — Hurts is still in their quarterback slot
body: Bad news first: Rice and Barkley missed practice Wednesday and Thursday and ESPN projects both at 0.0; Jason Myers, whom you dropped for Matt Gay, kicked 7.0 on Thursday night, so Gay needs more than that at home to Buffalo. And Jacksonville's Week 7 bye takes Lawrence, your only quarterback, with Tuten and Strange.

This week: 119.5 as set, which is the projection lineup, against 85.7. You trail 0 to 5.2 only because Emanuel Wilson played Thursday. Los Cachanillas claimed Kirk Cousins at 07:43 UTC but left Jalen Hurts (out) at quarterback; their defence slot holds the Vikings, on bye, and their flex Quinshon Judkins, who missed practice Wednesday and Thursday.

case.label: Why it can tighten
case.body: Cousins into their quarterback slot adds 17.4 (Raiders' starter, RotoBaller), and any defence adds about 7: their ceiling is near 110 before Judkins's status.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing on your side: no starter is in doubt. Rice or Barkley practising Friday would only restore bench depth.
